summary: Patches the automotive compatibility release onto DjangoLux 1.9.2, replacing the problematic 1.9.1 runtime.
highlights: Automotive Compatibility is off by default, so existing stores keep their current screens and queries.
Admins can configure chassis, engine, fuel, trim, transmission and position criteria from one settings card.
Separate scoped fitment tables reference Product without adding automotive fields to the core catalog or stock schema.
Managers can maintain vehicle reference data and save several validated compatibility ranges from a Product card.
Product cards and keyword search expose enabled vehicle criteria while disabled features and criteria remain unreachable.
A query-parameter vehicle browser provides distinct-SKU counts, broad-fitment matching, stock status, and direct Product search.
The permission-gated automotive hub can be added to the sidebar after the enhancement is saved as enabled.
The application and release image now pin DjangoLux 1.9.2 exactly instead of 1.9.1.
